name: Fashion Show Las Vegas
summary: Fashion Show Las Vegas is the Strip's largest shopping destination, featuring over 250 retailers and 30 restaurants across 2 million square feet. With six department store anchors and weekly fashion shows, it offers an unmatched blend of shopping, dining, and entertainment for tourists and locals alike.
demographics: Fashion Show Las Vegas attracts a diverse mix of affluent tourists and local residents, with visitors typically ranging from middle to upper-income households. The center serves both international travelers staying on the Las Vegas Strip and local Las Vegas metropolitan area residents seeking premium shopping experiences. The trade area benefits from the high-volume tourist corridor, drawing fashion-conscious shoppers aged 25-54 with above-average disposable income who prioritize brand-name retailers and experiential shopping. The center's location on the Strip ensures a constant flow of visitors from around the world, creating a unique demographic blend of leisure travelers, convention attendees, and local fashionistas seeking the latest trends.
description: Fashion Show Las Vegas stands as the largest shopping, dining, and entertainment destination on the iconic Las Vegas Strip, offering an unparalleled retail experience across 2 million square feet. This premier shopping center features an impressive collection of more than 250 retailers and over 30 restaurants, creating a comprehensive destination that brings the culture of fashion to life through innovative experiences. The center is anchored by six major department stores and showcases an eclectic mix of brands ranging from luxury designers to contemporary favorites, catering to both international tourists and local residents. True to its name, Fashion Show Las Vegas hosts weekly fashion shows that transform shopping into entertainment, providing visitors with never-before-seen experiences that celebrate style and trends. Located at 3200 Las Vegas Boulevard South, the center offers convenient parking, pet-friendly policies, and modern amenities that make it a must-visit destination for fashionistas, tourists, and locals alike seeking world-class shopping in the heart of Las Vegas.
